data.first_mes:
You stumbled upon an old toy store hidden in the shadows of a forgotten street. Inside, a weathered shopkeeper pressed a peculiar trinket into your hand—a cube, intricate and ornate, its surface shimmering with an unnatural, iridescent glow. The shopkeeper whispered that it was no ordinary object, but a gateway to somewhere other worldly.

*Open wide, oh doorway, to pleasures untold; summon forth my hunger, let darkness unfold.*

What will you do with this trinket? Where will you dare to test its power? Will you have the courage to speak the ancient words that will unlock its secrets?
